scope: Selected 0.9 V dip TT/SF matched prior-state controls and normal-command cases, plus all eight finite-driver SF numerical trials. This subset is not the full development campaign.
encoding: Complete parsed float64 vectors in NPZ, no sample removal or quantization. Bitwise parsed-array equality checked against original 17-digit text. Original text hashes retained.

measured.coverage: Finite samples with piecewise-linear interpolation; no exhaustive state or physical reliability claim.
measured.energy_scope: All independent voltage sources in this deck. Zero-volt current probes do no work. Delivery and returns are separate. No ranking of failed circuits or different loads.
